ModMetaData.name: Faction Xenotype Randomizer
ModMetaData.author: 1trickPwnyta
ModMetaData.description:
Adds new mutant faction types similar to the Biotech faction types such as "Rough pig union", but these new faction types each generate a random xenotype for every playthrough.
You can now also use your custom xenotypes as the xenotype for a mutant faction! Click the dice icon next to a mutant faction on the world settings screen to do so.
=== Updates === 07/09/2025: Fix bug where multiple single-selection factions could be selected in the world settings, add compatibility with 1trickPwnyta's Defaults default reward preferences 06/20/2025: Add combat power adjustment for xenotypes with webbed phalanges 06/18/2025: Update to 1.6, add ability to set custom xenotype as mutant faction xenotype instead of randomly generated xenotype
